info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Term Deposit API
info.description: The Manage Term Deposit API allows users to update the details of existing term deposit accounts. This endpoint facilitates modifications such as interest rate adjustments, maturity date changes, and account holder information updates, ensuring customers have the most relevant terms aligned with their financial goals. Financial institutions and developers can leverage this API to enhance their banking applications, providing seamless customer experiences and promoting efficient account management. Typical consumers of this API include bank staff and third-party financial service applications that manage term deposits.

patch.summary: Update a term deposit by its identifier.
patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of an existing term deposit account identified by its unique ID. Users can update various attributes of the term deposit to reflect changes needed, such as interest rates or terms.
